name: wh-frontier-task-suite
description: Run a self-contained multi-agent workflow for Frontier-Bench task creation, review, repair, and release.

interface.shortDescription: Run a self-contained multi-agent task pipeline.
interface.longDescription: A coordinated Codex workflow with seven bundled Frontier-Bench references. It spawns isolated author, reviewer, repair, re-review, and release agents to create three original tasks and carry them through evidence-backed quality gates without a separate Frontier-Bench checkout or manual task switching.
defaultPrompt: Run the complete multi-agent Frontier-Bench pipeline from authoring through release.
Create three original Frontier-Bench tasks from one supported reference.
Independently audit a three-task Frontier-Bench submission.
Repair all actionable findings from an independent review report.
